description: Java class 'EwayServices' providing payment processing methods for eWAY gateway, including charge, refund, and release operations, with configuration handling and external service calls.

classes.name: EwayServices
classes.description: Contains static methods for processing payments via eWAY, including charge, refund, and release operations, with configuration management.

methods.name: ewayCharge
methods.description: Performs an authorization with capture for a payment, constructs request with card and billing info, sends request, and processes response.

methods.name: ewayRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund transaction for a previous payment, retrieves original transaction info, and sends refund request.

methods.name: ewayRelease
methods.description: Releases (refunds) a previously authorized transaction, with support for partial amounts.

methods.name: initRequest
methods.description: Initializes a GatewayRequest object with configuration parameters, determining request mode based on refund and beagle/cvn settings.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for the payment gateway, either from database or properties file.
